title: ML Trading Model Training Demo
author: Marshallmatta
selftext:
This is still in development, so if you like the app, a star would mean a lot.

I personally use Pine Script on TradingView for auto-trading. Lately I’ve been playing around with machine learning to see if there’s any edge in it. From what I’ve tested so far, ML can sometimes hit around a 51–55% win rate with a 2:1 risk-reward ratio.

It’s nothing amazing though — and once you add trading fees, it can wipe out a lot of the gains, especially on smaller accounts.

I’ll keep improving it, but probably at a slow pace. Feel free to use it, and if you run into any issues, just open an issue and I’ll take a look.  
  
[https://github.com/catowabisabi/Stock-Prediction-Trainer](https://github.com/catowabisabi/Stock-Prediction-Trainer)
